{{Locations|Abandoned Sector|LRSmap=noship|unique=true}}


The intro text for this event varies, and could be any of the following:
*''Aided by a modified translator, a nearby Lanius scavenger ship messages you, saying, "Metal sufficient. Request exchange." It appears there are some Lanius who wish sociable interaction with other races.''
*''A small Lanius craft approaches. You prepare for a fight but they do not seem to be carrying any weapons. After a brief moment they message you, although your translator struggles with the unfamiliar dialect. It appears they wish to trade.''
*''You arrive to find a large Lanius vessel laden with recently collected metal. They are apparently offering to trade for supplies they are lacking.''
*#Agree to the exchange. &nbsp;<span style="color:grey">[ the actual trade offer is shown before you make the choice ]</span>
*#*''After the exchange is complete they leave without a word.''
*#** You lose {{Transaction|3-7|subtract_fuel}} and receive {{Transaction|15-30|add_scrap}}.
*#** You lose {{Transaction|3-7|subtract_missiles}} and receive {{Transaction|20-40|add_scrap}}.
*#** You lose {{Transaction|3-7|subtract_drones}} and receive {{Transaction|20-40|add_scrap}}.
*#Decline.
*#*''They leave without a word.''
*#** Nothing happens.
*#{{Blue Option|Lanius Crew|Ask for an alternative trade.}}
*#*''After a short discussion you do not understand, the trader comes back with a second proposal.''
*#*#Agree to the exchange. &nbsp;<span style="color:grey">[ the actual trade offer is shown before you make the choice ]</span>
*#*#*''After the exchange is complete they leave without a word.''
*#*#** You lose {{Transaction|3-7|subtract_fuel}} and receive {{Transaction|20-35|add_scrap}}.
*#*#** You lose {{Transaction|3-7|subtract_missiles}} and receive {{Transaction|25-50|add_scrap}}.
*#*#** You lose {{Transaction|3-7|subtract_drones}} and receive {{Transaction|25-50|add_scrap}}.
*#*#Decline.
*#*#*''They leave without a word.''
*#*#** Nothing happens.

==Notes==
This event is called "LANIUS_TRADER" in the datafiles. 
* This event offers similar trades to the [[Lanius trader with translator]] event but does '''not''' have an option to get a Lanius named Translator, as suggested by the intro texts. Instead, a blue option to get a better trade is present on this event.
* Using the Lanius blue option will make a new, different roll for a resource and its amount and for the scrap reward amount: a player can get a far better price for the the same resource (even for the same or lesser amount) or receive an offer to trade a different resource. However, a less beneficial outcome (in all regards) is also possible.
